cases.name: CHK-003 adversarial: if stale metadata comes back gap_analyze would fail this guard
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const raw = execFileSync('node', [$root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js', 'gap_analyze'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8' }); const json = JSON.parse(raw.slice(raw.indexOf('{'))); const stale = json.gaps.filter((g) => g.type === 'no_test' && (g.description.includes('tools-flow_trace') || g.description.includes('tools-flow_list'))); return { noStaleFlowNoTest: stale.length === 0 };
